Product Inquiry.description: We sell laptops, smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, headphones, keyboards, mice, and accessories.
Product Inquiry.availability: Product availability depends on current stock.
Product Inquiry.working_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Order Status.delivery_time: Orders are usually delivered within 3 to 5 business days.
Order Status.tracking: Customers can track orders using their Order ID from the Track Order page.
Order Status.shipping: Free shipping is available on orders above ₹999.
Order Status.delay: During festivals or bad weather, delivery may be delayed.
Order Status.cancel_order: Orders can be cancelled before shipment.

Returns & Refunds.return_policy: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused and in their original packaging.
Returns & Refunds.refund_time: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the returned product passes inspection.
Returns & Refunds.replacement: Replacement is available for damaged or defective products.

Technical Support.warranty: Most electronic products include a one-year manufacturer warranty.
Technical Support.service_center: Authorized service centers are available in major cities.
Technical Support.contact: If the issue continues, contact our technical support team.

Payment.security: All payments are secured using encrypted payment gateways.

Shipping.express: Express delivery is available for selected cities.

Account.registration: Customers can create an account using their email address.
Account.password_reset: Password reset is available using the registered email address.

General Query.description: Answer politely and professionally. If information is unavailable in the knowledge base, ask the customer to contact customer support.
